title.narrative: Special Measure to support the response to the refugee and migrant situation in BiH Phase III

description.narrative: This project is the third phase of the EU Special Measures to Support the Response to the Refugee and Migrant Situation in Bosnia and Herzegovina (BiH). The overall objective of the action is to support BiH in migration, reception and border management in the context of the increased number of migrants, asylum seekers and refugees who have entered the country since the end of 2017. The primary focus of the action will be to maintain ongoing activities supporting the coordination and management of reception centres that provide for the basic food and shelter needs of PoCs, including water sanitation and hygiene (WASH), and facilitate access to protection services and provide transportation to school for migrant and refugee children. Special attention will be given to persons with vulnerabilities and special needs, such as children, in particular Unaccompanied and Separated Children (UASC), single parents traveling with children, single women, and pregnant women, through improved identification and referral pathways.
